summary: Brand Engagement Network filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) updating expected cost reductions tied to integrating Cataneo GmbH, acquired June 30, 2026. Post-closing organizational actions (Phase II and III), authorized by the CEO in the ordinary course, carry one-time exit costs estimated near $177,000, mostly severance and notice pay, largely payable in the first half of 2027. Combined annualized savings across Phases I–III are now projected at roughly $1.919 million, mostly realized in 2027. No board recommendation, advisor, or price terms disclosed; watch severance timing and integration execution risk.
